bullets: How complementary inspection and metrology techniques can detect smaller defects and distinguish among a wide range of defect types within a unified workflow.
In advanced packaging, value accumulates layer by layer, component by component, and process step by process step.
By the time chiplets, high-bandwidth memory stacks, or hybrid-bonded devices reach assembly, manufacturers have invested substantial material and processing resources in those devices.
An undetected defect at this stage can place the larger assembly at risk.
Compounding this challenge, shrinking package features are bringing advanced packaging requirements closer to the tolerances historically associated with front-end fabrication.

backlog.title: Building a safer path to autonomous industrial AI

backlog.title: We’re putting too much faith in AI’s ability to say no

A monolithically integrated... » read more
The post Monolithic 3D Memristor-TFT Stack For Programmable Neuromorphic Computing (SNU, Yonsei) appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Researchers have demonstrated a monolithically integrated memristor-TFT stack that enables electrically programmable temporal dynamics for reservoir computing.
By vertically integrating Ru/HfO2/TiN memristors with In2O3 channel TFTs, the system overcomes the fixed dynamics typically found in hardware-based neural reservoirs.
This 3D integration approach provides a more flexible framework for processing temporal information, which is essential for advanced neuromorphic computing applications.

backlog.title: Deterministic Nucleation Enables Controlled Growth of 2D Semiconductors (KAIST, TDS, Hanyang et al.)
backlog.summary:
Researchers at KAIST, TDS Innovation, Hanyang University, UNIST, et al. published a technical paper titled “Spatially deterministic nucleation of 2D semiconductors by etching flux.” Abstract Excerpt: “Nucleation control is fundamental to semiconductor deposition, governing when, where and how crystalline materials form. Conventional strategies can regulate nucleation density and, through area-selective growth, confine deposition to designated... » read more
The post Deterministic Nucleation Enables Controlled Growth of 2D Semiconductors (KAIST, TDS, Hanyang et al.) appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: A new technique using etching-flux-mediated nucleation allows for the precise, single-centered growth of 2D semiconductors.
This method overcomes the stochastic nature of conventional deposition, where individual nucleus formation is typically random and difficult to control.
Deterministic control over nucleation sites is a fundamental advancement for the scalable and reliable manufacturing of crystalline 2D materials.

backlog.title: The Download: moon city problems and drone traffic controllers
backlog.summary: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. Mars may be a hellhole, but the moon is not far behind The US and China are racing to build bases on the moon, with NASA hoping to establish a small…
bullets: NASA and China are engaged in a competitive race to establish permanent lunar bases, with plans for autonomous robotics, nuclear power, and resource extraction.
Brimstone, a climate tech startup, is pivoting its value proposition to align with shifting political climates by marketing both low-carbon cement and critical mineral extraction.
The emergence of drone delivery services is creating a new labor market for specialized air traffic controllers to manage low-altitude urban airspace.

backlog.title: Smart #2 debuts in Paris as Couture Edition launches in China
backlog.summary:
The Couture Edition costs 112,999 yuan ($16,790) in China, with production limited to 999 units each for China and Europe.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Smart, a joint venture between Mercedes-Benz and Geely, has unveiled the all-electric #2, a successor to the classic ForTwo city car.
The limited-run Couture Edition is priced at 112,999 yuan in China, with production capped at 999 units for both the Chinese and European markets.
The vehicle utilizes a 35.8-kWh LFP battery, offering a CLTC range of 410 km in China and a WLTP range of 290 km in Europe.
Designed for ultra-compact urban mobility, the #2 features a specialized Electric Compact Architecture and unique design elements like a split tailgate.

backlog.title: China September NEV retail sales fall 16.7% as penetration hits record 67%, CPCA data shows
backlog.summary:
China's NEV retail sales totaled 1.084 million in September, down 16.7% year-on-year for a ninth consecutive monthly decline.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: China's NEV retail sales fell by 16.7% year-on-year in September, marking the ninth consecutive month of decline in the retail segment.
Despite the retail sales drop, NEV market penetration reached a record high of 67% during the month.
The divergence between wholesale figures and retail sales suggests a potential buildup in inventory or a shift in distribution channels for Chinese automakers.

backlog.title: The ecologist revealing the invisible networks that revive rainforests
backlog.summary: In a research station in central Panama, you can walk through a century of forest time, watching scrubby plots of adolescent trees give way to cathedral-­like canopies of mature growth. Forest ecologist Daisy Dent, a senior scientist at ETH Zurich, oversees this sequence of plots across the Barro Colorado Nature Monument, some of which date…
bullets: Research by ecologist Daisy Dent suggests that natural forest regeneration is a more effective and resilient carbon sequestration strategy than human-led monocrop tree-planting programs.
Data from the Barro Colorado Nature Monument indicates that animal-led seed dispersal, particularly by fruit-eating species, is responsible for over 70% of tropical forest growth.
The findings challenge current carbon-crediting models, suggesting that high-impact, low-cost climate solutions should prioritize protecting biodiversity to facilitate natural ecosystem recovery.

backlog.title: Xpeng steps up Australia, New Zealand push with Mona L03 launch

Mona L03 SUV is Xpeng's third model in the 2 markets, following the G6 SUV and X9 MPV.

bullets: Xpeng has expanded its footprint in Australia and New Zealand with the launch of the Mona L03 SUV.

This launch is part of Xpeng's broader strategy to diversify its international presence beyond Europe and the Middle East.
